John initially planned to sell all his toys, but he only needed enough money to buy the video games and have $5 left. He bought 8 video games at $20 each, spending \(8 \times 20 = \$160\). With $5 left, the total money he got from selling Lego sets is \(160 + 5 = \$165\). Since each Lego set sells for $15, he sold \(165 \div 15 = 11\) sets. He started with 13 sets, so he still has \(13 - 11 = 2\) sets.

Answer: 2
